text:
elaine: Quick check — finalizing the HTTP contract for our job endpoints. Posting current assumptions, pls 👍 or call out issues.

elaine: Summary: POST /v1/jobs -> 202 + Location header (status URL) and response body with request_id. Polling GET /v1/jobs/{id}/status returns canonical status object. Cancel via POST /v1/jobs/{id}:cancel.

elaine: Example responses we're proposing:
```
POST /v1/jobs  -> 202
Location: /v1/jobs/rid_abc123/status
Body: {"request_id":"rid_abc123","status_endpoint":"/v1/jobs/rid_abc123/status"}

GET /v1/jobs/rid_abc123/status -> 200
{
  "request_id":"rid_abc123",
  "status":"pending|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled",
  "progress": 0,
  "result_url": null,
  "error": null
}
```

aditya: Question: what is the canonical format for request_id? We should pick a stable prefix (rid_) + uuid v4 to avoid collisions. Also confirm we guarantee idempotency for repeated POST with same client-provided idempotency-key.

elaine: Yep — plan: server-generated rid_ prefix by default, but support optional client_id field in body for user-supplied idempotency key. If client_id provided, we return 409 if mismatch with existing job metadata.

sam: How should retries behave? If client retries POST (network blip) with no client_id, we create dup jobs. Do we want to accept Idempotency-Key header?

elaine: Good call. We'll accept Idempotency-Key header. If present, server will dedupe requests for 24h. Document that in API.

julie: Cancel semantics: if a cancel request hits while job is finishing, what's the truth? Proposed: cancel becomes best-effort — status transitions: running -> cancelling -> cancelled if worker acknowledges within N secs; if worker finishes first, status becomes succeeded. We need clear race description.

matt: For the HTTP codes: cancel POST should return 202 if cancel accepted and 409 if job already terminal. Also return current status in body. Example: POST /v1/jobs/rid/cancel -> 202 {"request_id":"rid","status":"cancelling"} or 409 {"request_id":"rid","status":"succeeded"}.

elaine: Also propose a short TTL for cancelling window: worker must acknowledge cancel within 30s, otherwise we mark cancelled and rely on out-of-band cleanup. Ops ok w/ that?

sre-bot: load-test: cancel window 30s -> median cancel ack seen 12s, 95th 48s on current infra. Suggest 60s default to be safe; can add config per pool.

aditya: Another edge: what if client polls after server returns 202 but before job record is created in DB (race with eventual consistency)? Suggest status endpoint returns 404 for unknown id for up to X seconds, then 200 with pending. Better: create job record synchronously before returning 202 to avoid 404.

elaine: We will create job record sync. No 404 expected for returned request_id. If someone queries random id, 404 is fine.

devex-bot: SDK note: current JS SDK expects POST -> 201 with body. We'll add support for 202 + Location and expose polling helper that follows Location header. Need doc changes.

matt: Timeouts: what should polling clients do? Recommend: exponential backoff with jitter, stop polling after 10m by default but make configurable. Also add server-sent Event stream for long-running jobs in future.

julie: Status schema note: include optional "started_at" and "finished_at" ISO8601 fields, and "estimated_remaining_seconds" for UX use. Keep error typed: {"code":"RESOURCE_ERR","message":"...","details":{}}.

elaine: Agreed. We'll add started_at, finished_at, estimated_remaining_seconds, and standardize error codes.

sam: Backward compatibility: existing clients expect immediate result for short jobs. We should keep quick synchronous path for <500ms ops and return 200 w/ result. For anything long, use 202+Location. Document threshold and how to detect branch.

aditya: One more: auth scoping — status endpoint should accept same bearer token and return 403 if caller doesn't own job. Also admin role can see all.

elaine: Great. Action items:
- aditya: draft idempotency spec + Idempotency-Key behavior (due EOD Fri)
- devex-bot: update JS SDK polling helper + add tests (PR pls)
- julie: write cancel race doc + state machine diagram (add to repo)
- matt: update error codes list + HTTP code mapping

elaine: FYI @matt @julie @aditya I'll open a PR with the updated swagger file and examples. Ping me for reviews — want to ship this next week.

matt: ack, will review.

julie: ack, will sketch state diagram tomorrow.

aditya: putting a draft in #api-specs in 30m.

elaine: thanks all :tada:

sre-bot: CI: job-api-contract-tests passed (12/12) — small flakiness noted on cancel path in aws-pool-2 (see CI link)
